name: ClassNet
description: A collaborative virtual classroom platform where teachers create classrooms with unique entry codes and students join to engage in discussion forums, receive assignments, submit tasks, and view instructor feedback and grading.

name: EduScholar
description: Centralizes university scholarship discovery and applications. Features dynamic scholarship management, admin dashboard for role management, and streamlined student application status tracking.

name: TechTALKS
description: A full-featured technology blogging and community platform where users create, edit, and curate tech articles, share resources, and interact through comments.

name: Canvas Creations
description: An interactive e-commerce and gallery platform for artisans to showcase, add, update, and manage craft items with secure authentication and real-time inventory updates.
